name: ahadu-online-learning-api

scripts.kill:port: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$pids = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique); if ($pids) { $pids | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force }; Write-Host 'Killed process(es) listening on port 5000:' $pids } else { Write-Host 'No process is listening on port 5000' }"

author: Ahadu Online Learning Team
description: Backend API for Ahadu Online Learning Platform
